channel.title: Two Dimensional Love
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Two Dimensional Love" - Sounds good on paper, doesn't it?

item.title: Re: Two Dimensional Love
item.content:encoded:
If you expanded on the "lovesick" side of the trope a bit, it could be interesting, where the doll punishes the man for leaving her alone for too long. Also, the western otaku angle would be interesting, as well as fit into the AWCY philosophy.

It would also be interesting to look into her sentience, especially in terms of various Japanese revenge tales. That is, is she based on a real woman who was wronged in real life, and the doll gives her a chance to get that revenge.

It's a good idea, it just needs to be fleshed out some.

item.title: Re: Two Dimensional Love
item.content:encoded: Apologies for the needless edge, I based the idea on a nightmare I had and rushed into it. The idea was that the doll was based on the "yandere" anime trope, and I planned to expand on that in the experiment logs with incidents such as a victim being brought out of the trance only to be butchered the next time he goes in, with the implication being that the doll doesn't like being "abandoned". But I really like the cultural appropriation idea, what if instead of a lonely Japanese man it's a Western otaku who ends up being killed by it due to messing with things he doesn't truly understand?

item.title: Re: Two Dimensional Love
item.content:encoded:
[+] Open for crit
– hide block

Subject is inanimate but believed to be sentient.

Why do they think the scp is sentient?

Any male who enters the doll's line of "sight" has an approximate 3% chance of being imprinted on, upon which its effect manifests. Upon entering REM sleep, the victim has a 50% chance to enter a state similar to sleep paralysis, in which a vision of the doll will appear to them and gently caress them, leaving deep wounds.

This feels like it'd be pretty uncommon to occur and it feels like it raises questions like 'how did anyone discover this' and 'why does it only affect 3% of people'?

Any female (biological or transgender) the victim interacts with that is not of blood relation enters a similar state the next time they sleep in which they are executed in a manner similar to the Chinese Lingchi. This process is not painless.

This feels….weirdly cruel?

Article proceeds normally, with an addendum regarding its recovery from the belongings of a deceased Japanese man implied to be its creator after his "suicide" in police custody. Several experiment logs are listed near the end with the Foundation using D-Class to determine how it works.

So like…my concern here is that it feels like these experiment logs just won't really be interesting and they also feel like the kinda meat of this article? Like, the anomaly behaves in a way that's relatively straight forward and so I'm not sure what doing experiment logs adds to this beyond what's laid out in the description, y'know?

At the end of the day, this feels…kinda needlessly edgy but without any kind of pay off to it. It leaves an unpleasant taste in my mouth, though I can't quite put my finger on why; but it also feels like you don't really do much with the concept: like, this feels like the kinda thing that could be a huge inspection of how e.g. westerners appropriate japanese culture, or like, investigating the role gender plays here or something like that but instead we just have a generic doll that effectively fucks you to death and I'm really not that into that played straight, y'know?

item.title: Two Dimensional Love
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Elevator Pitch:

  • A bloodstained kirigami paper doll 1.56 meters in length drawn on to resemble a female human in an anime style, wearing gothic "lolita" style attire. Edges of the paper are abnormally sharp and capable of inflicting wounds on contact far greater than the amount of pressure and composition of the fibers would allow for. Subject is inanimate but believed to be sentient.
  • Any male who enters the doll's line of "sight" has an approximate 3% chance of being imprinted on, upon which its effect manifests. Upon entering REM sleep, the victim has a 50% chance to enter a state similar to sleep paralysis, in which a vision of the doll will appear to them and gently caress them, leaving deep wounds. This process is painless but can still result in complications from blood loss or infection.
  • Any female (biological or transgender) the victim interacts with that is not of blood relation enters a similar state the next time they sleep in which they are executed in a manner similar to the Chinese Lingchi. This process is not painless.
  • If the victim has not expired after a period of seven days, they will progress to Stage 2 in which they have an approximate 12.5% chance of the doll attempting to copulate with them. This normally results in death by blood loss. Only one affected victim can exist at a time.

Central Narrative: Article proceeds normally, with an addendum regarding its recovery from the belongings of a deceased Japanese man implied to be its creator after his "suicide" in police custody. Several experiment logs are listed near the end with the Foundation using D-Class to determine how it works.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Final experiment log has the Foundation manage to keep a D-Class alive long enough to describe Stage 2 to them. He explains that the doll, which was silent before then, kept repeating a single phrase: "Mō kakkoīdesu ka?" (Japanese for "Are we cool yet?")
